# Learnwith

> Learnwith is an interactive learning site by Abhijeet Kakade. It currently has introductory lessons on system design and Avalanche blockchain.

- [Home](https://learnwith.abhijeetkakade.in/): Choose a topic and explore the interactive notebook.
- [System Design](https://learnwith.abhijeetkakade.in/learn/system-design/): Trace a web request through a device, server, and database.
- [Avalanche Blockchain](https://learnwith.abhijeetkakade.in/learn/avalanche/): Follow a transaction from wallet to validators.

Lessons are introductory and interactive. The site is free to explore without an account.
